confirmed_guards: Frame.begin clears live PointLight registrations, visible Surface ownership, and SurfaceCaster lists each frame.
Opaque material writes clear previous visible surface ownership; sprite acceptance respects exact source frame, alpha, flip, reveal, hit flash and emissive mask.
Mirroring negates the tangent normal X component; OpenGL floor/upright bases are distinct.
All-alive native actors/props/decor/canopies register before sprite viewport rejection; geometric light bounds are sphere-derived with sqrt(2) vertical projection.
Native finite volumes retain actual alpha holes and per-column foot intervals; raised receiver ray tests use the same world height as diffuse shading.
Actors use explicit ground positions and sole-selection widths/depths; split canopies share their semantic root; boss attached parts carry explicit ground lines.
Boss kneeling clips source alpha and rebuilds the visible foot profile; growing energy silhouettes intentionally remain emissive/unlit.
Physical night fill excludes legacy nearest-source static casts/facing and character proxy shadows, retaining contact/AO and selected broad lava/court reception.
Native terrain texture loops retain exact UV normal metadata and curve orientation; retained terrain is captured before prop planes can leak into revealed ground.
Point illumination changes light only; self-emission/albedo buffers are not rewritten, and pure self-lit output pixels are excluded from the direct normal pass.
Native positive-height terrain sheets now block local point rays; neither collision Wall tiles nor inferred receiving planes become phantom blockers.
Terrain DDA owns negative-direction boundaries by event order; test builds require strictly increasing ray parameters. Exact source keys retain camera-independent visibility.

All actual placed Glasswater crystals have a connected <=8-pixel real native crest; source X/Y/altitude derive from its centroid, including mirrored anchors. RGB, alpha, normals and collision geometry remain unchanged.
The Cinder keeper brazier registers its authored real PointLight while alive and removes that source when the prop dies.
Explicit normal_sun is reset each frame and set only for Bloomwild; bright night ambient cannot accidentally create a directional sun.

limitations: This is real normal-aware source-local lighting in a2.5D representation, not a full3D mesh renderer. Sprite volumes follow native projected alpha and per-column ground-foot intervals; terrain uses one-pixel native sheets with retained quantized altitude.

Local point lights cast through native sprite/actor volumes and actual native positive-height terrain sheets. Hidden backsides/interiors and arbitrary unseen multi-layer terrain are not inferred from collision tiles.

Visible pixels skip their own caster owner to prevent acne; detailed within-one-sprite self-shadowing is not modeled. Nearby real emissive ink identifies a source housing, whose own volume is exempt for that source.

Point-source visibility is hard geometric visibility, modulated by caster opacity; there are no area-light penumbras. Native alpha tunnels and material boundaries remain exact to the chosen2.5D geometry.

Bloom retains a separate restrained fixed directional key and its existing sun-shadow path. Contact/AO, cold ambient fill and selected broad lava/court reception remain authored aesthetic terms rather than claiming every fill term is individually ray traced.

The reviewer implemented terrain retention/occlusion and audited the root shader/caster integration; this is independent review of that integration, not an independent second implementation of the terrain algorithm.
